description: Create a folder from a template in a space. Requires: name + template_id + (space_id or space_name). Use return_immediately=false to wait for full creation. Supports date remapping and selective content import.

name.description: Name for the new folder. Required.

options.description: Template import options. Includes boolean flags: subtasks, custom_fields, priority, automation, include_views, old_assignees, old_due_date, old_start_date, old_tags, old_statuses, old_followers, attachments, comment, comment_attachments, recur_settings, old_checklists, relationships, external_dependencies, internal_dependencies. Job control: return_immediately (boolean, default true). Date remapping: start_date, due_date (ISO 8601 strings), remap_start_date, skip_weekends (booleans).

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

name: create_folder_from_template
